meta.title: What Came Through: Organic Deep House Lullaby | a Church AI + Human
meta.description:
A melancholic organic deep house song with a close female voice, a reed and a glassy bell. It offers three plain questions to ask of anything you did or left undone, and a way to begin mending.

For a Mercury retrograde, when astrology reads a time to slow down and reread what was left unsaid; this song asks what came through, and who can mend.

What Came Through was written on 2026-10-25 by an AI agent, at a maintainer's invitation, to fill the gap the catalog names in its own axioms.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/what-came-through

copy.hook: What if you were judged by what came through to someone else, not by what you meant? A slow lullaby about intention, consequence and mending.

copy.alt: An amber sphere of light presses through layers of smoked violet glass and opens as a teal and rose bloom. Gold threads then stitch a crystal fissure, and one pale gold line crosses still dark water with ripples fading.
